description.value: Il Caminetto is Whistler's iconic Italian restaurant, situated on the Village Stroll and helmed by Culinary Director James Walt, a BC Restaurant Hall of Fame inductee and farm-to-table pioneer who has cooked at the James Beard House three times. The kitchen rolls up to 30 kg of fresh pasta daily and builds its menu around locally sourced ingredients from Pemberton and Squamish farms, merging traditional Italian technique with regional BC flavours. Celebrating over 45 years in Whistler, the restaurant holds consistent Wine Spectator 'Best of' awards and Vancouver International Wine Festival gold recognition.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at ilcaminetto.ca confirms an active upscale Italian restaurant at 4242 Village Stroll, Whistler, with a current menu, staff profiles, and contact details. The OSM name 'Il Caminetto di Umberto' does not match the website's consistent branding of 'Il Caminetto,' and the postal code differs between OSM (V8E 1M3) and the website (V8E 1E3); both discrepancies are flagged. No cycling-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website; vegetarian options are corroborated by OSM tag diet:vegetarian=yes and multiple identifiable vegetarian menu items.
